name: screen1
purpose: Screening: does a fold appear at any setting? 16 Latin-hypercube runs on tiles 1 of the Pattern 1 matrix, yarn only (no shell), tension fixed at 10 cN.

estimate.per_run_minutes: 5.2 (formula) to 6.4 (corrected by the old tiles-3 jobs)
estimate.basis: 2.9e-4 s x 13481 vertices x 80 sub-rounds = 313 s plus startup; the 16 runs are one after another

ranges.ref_scale: 0 to 1: argparse help and UI limits; the solver notes report smooth behaviour at 0.3 and 0.6. SOURCED as limits.
ranges.bend_scale: 1e-3 to 1 (log): lower end = Sperl et al. 2022 range (1e-3..10) and Ding et al. 0.0032 for acrylic; upper end = UI limit. Not measured for cotton Ne 12.
ranges.seed_stitch: 0 to 0.5 x R: UI limit is -1..1; the 0.5 upper end is UNSOURCED.
ranges.curl: 0 to 0.05 rad per vertex: UI limit is 0..0.5; the 0.05 upper end is UNSOURCED (the last real job used 0.01).
ranges.length_ratio: 0.85 to 1.0: UNSOURCED. The UI limit is 0.5..1; relax_job help: eta < 1 = yarn knitted tighter than built (Ding et al. 2023, A.7), but no value for cotton Ne 12 is sourced.
ranges.tension: fixed at 10 cN (SOURCED: lowest of the cotton circular-knitting values 10, 20, 30 cN cited in webui/main.py); no longer varied.

unsourced: relax.mu 0.49 (copied from earlier runs, no source)
relax.kc_ratio 30 (webui default, numerical choice tested on one fabric)
thresholds.* (classification thresholds for the metrics, chosen by the author)
sourced: relax.E 3700 MPa: Kharkova et al. 2011 (webui/main.py CONFIG)
